intro: Compare Hyperbound, Yoodli, PitchMonster and Gong AI Trainer for SDR practice. See what you can try, what needs a quote and how to tell whether the feedback is worth paying for.

detailTitle: Which AI roleplay tool should your team buy?

details.title: Hyperbound: try the outbound pack first
details.what: The free plan lists prebuilt roleplays and example scorecards. Practice adds custom AI buyers and scorecards. Perform adds real-call scoring and broader coaching features.
details.action: Price the Practice plan on its own.
details.why: Upgrade to Perform when your managers need to score live calls as well as practice sessions.

details.title: Yoodli: start with one rep’s delivery
details.what: The individual Starter plan has five lifetime sessions. Pro allows up to ten per week. Business adds custom roleplays, rubrics, dashboards and admin controls.
details.action: Try it with one caller before involving the whole team.
details.why: Check whether the feedback catches a moment when the rep talked over the buyer or missed a question.

details.title: PitchMonster: ask it to reproduce your onboarding
details.what: The roleplay plan includes custom scenarios, scorecards and certifications. The larger plan includes call analysis and a Gong integration. PitchMonster lists a standard 12-month contract and shorter options.
details.action: Get the shorter term priced first.
details.why: Ask managers to assign a scenario, inspect a weak attempt and see whether the rep improves on the retry. Test those steps before committing to a year.

details.title: Gong AI Trainer: check what your Gong contract covers
details.what: Gong documents AI Trainer on Enable. Managers can set up training modules and practice with AI buyer personas based on customer interactions already captured in Gong. A scenario can use an automatic scorecard.
details.action: Get your own access and renewal costs in writing.
details.why: Ask for the cost of adding Enable to your current contract. Include the platform fee and licences in a quote for a new Gong rollout.

sections.title: Run the same three cold call scenarios
sections.intro: Use a real buyer role and offer with made-up names. Give each simulator the same brief and run each situation twice.
sections.caption: A short trial for SDRs and their coaches
headers: What a useful simulation should expose
rows: “I’ve got 15 seconds.”
The rep asks one clear question, stops speaking and hears the buyer’s answer.
“Send me information.”
The rep asks what would be useful. The scorecard leaves room for the buyer to decline a follow-up.
“How did you get my number?”
The rep explains the source plainly. When the buyer asks to stop, the rep ends the call.
copy: Rehearse from the send-me-information video and the four contact-source replies. Ask the manager and the tool to score the same attempt.
Ask the vendor how it retains and deletes recordings before uploading client calls. Check where managers can view attempts and how to export progress.

sections.title: Gong AI Trainer vs. Hyperbound: which should you try first?
sections.intro: Give both vendors one exercise based on an objection your team hears. In Gong, check how the exercise draws from past calls. In Hyperbound, check what a manager can change about the buyer and scorecard.
copy: For either tool, check whether a manager can point to the moment the rep missed a cue. An overall score is easier to act on when it shows the line or pause that earned it.
For replacing your recording or conversation intelligence stack, use 10 Best Gong Alternatives. For reviewing live calls with a manager, use the cold call coaching scorecard.

checkIntro: Score each item Yes, Partly or Missed. Ask the rep to fix one thing on the second attempt.
checkText: Did the rep state a relevant reason for the call?
Did the rep pause and listen after the first question?
Did the response address what the buyer actually said?
Did the rep agree a next step or end the call cleanly?

faqs.q: What is AI cold call roleplay?
faqs.a: A rep speaks to a simulated buyer and practices how to open, handle objections and end the call. Some products grade the attempt against a team rubric.

faqs.q: What is the best free AI tool to practice cold calls?
faqs.a: Start with Hyperbound’s free prebuilt outbound scenarios or Yoodli Starter’s five lifetime sessions. Try the same exercise and compare the feedback before choosing a paid plan.

faqs.q: Does Gong have AI sales roleplay?
faqs.a: Yes. Gong documents AI Trainer on Enable. Check access and pricing with your administrator or Gong.

faqs.q: How does PitchMonster compare with Yoodli?
faqs.a: Compare PitchMonster for assigned sales practice and certification. Start with Yoodli for one rep’s delivery practice, then price Business if you need custom exercises and team management.

faqs.q: Can AI roleplay replace a sales coach?
faqs.a: Use it to give reps more practice between coaching sessions. A manager can then listen to the rep’s live calls, test whether the change carried over and coach the next improvement.
